notes.title: Minor Update
notes.notes:
List now shows production for each guy
 Prestige formulas have been updated to be more reasonable
 Minor invisible bug fixes
 100 prestige achievement is now 25 prestige

notes.title: Idle Games Fest Update
notes.notes:
Somehow Steam actually accepted this in the idle games fest so I figure I should update it. Here's a list of new things:
Easy exit

 Press Esc to exit (game saves on exit). Luxury.

Total production calculation improved

 more efficient (fewer machine resources used)
 not recalculated every frame anymore

Display of numbers improved

 Added decimals for smaller numbers
 Added large number words (million, billion, etc.)

More production tiers added
Offline progress (up to 24 hours)
More achievements for unlocked tiers
Prestige

 Resets production numbers and adds to prestige points
 Prestige points multiply production
 Points increase exponentially

Added something like 22 new achievements
Note that prestige points increase exponentially but that doesn't mean monies production will.
